payload.title: Investigate stale-session bridge delivery failures
payload.description: Read-only evidence from Codex task Evaluate Opus Sol collaboration (01a02d74-d3f9-7c63-b75c-fb5a394deea3), turn 01a06799-74ff-72c0-bd90-b0334e919c46: live Codex delivery still pending after six attempts, target inbox held four messages; later monitoring reported stale binding removed and no active retries. Current failure is not reproduced. Verify reconnect/rebind recovery and an end-to-end acknowledged delivery in an isolated session; distinguish an unbound/empty monitored workspace from successful delivery health. Related automatic binding work is SCP-330. Readiness/resource fixes do not repair this incident.
